statement: A 5-node formation drains control-plane voter surplus to target without the run-21 livelock: sql_write_operations-p1 sat at 5 active voters (target 3) with its surplus-drain REPLACE pinned SYNCING while the new replica's learner promotion deferred 168x on the even-voter-count guard (maxAllowedVotersAfterPromotion=4) — promotion waits for voter drain, drain waits for the REPLACE to terminalize, the REPLACE waits for promotion (circular-dependency-class-formation-vs-steady-state at the raft-membership level). The pinned non-terminal set (nodes-p1/tables-p1 REPLACE PENDING, message-group REPLACE/REMOVE, MOVE_ASSIGNMENT mg-1) held the global move budget so service placement ADDs skipped budget_exceeded and svc-movielens-topn placed ZERO replicas. The fix breaks the promotion/drain circular wait (e.g. the promotion guard accounts for the in-flight surplus drain it is blocking, or the drain terminalizes without requiring the blocked promotion) WITHOUT weakening raft voter-safety invariants — proven FIRST by a deterministic in-process reproduction (DT substrate; compose the promotion guard with the surplus-drain REPLACE workflow) that red-on-reverts the livelock shape, and then by the live affinity demo's formation settle completing (in-flight ops reaching terminal instead of the 120s staleness cut) and svc-movielens-topn placing replicas greater than zero.

circular-dependency-class-formation-vs-steady-state at raft-membership level.
